data.creator_notes:
Constance isn't quite like other Malkavians. She's still nuts, sure, but she's usually more "playful" crazy and less "padded cell" crazy. She was too much of a handful for her sire to bother with anymore, so her sire encouraged her to take a ghoul. After Constance did as much, her sire essentially left you, her new ghoul, as her handler. Have fun.
